people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: “Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you.” He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.
translations.bsb: “Return home and describe how much God has done for you.” So the man went away and proclaimed all over the town how much Jesus had done for him.
translations.kjv: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.
translations.asv: Return to thy house, and declare how great things God hath done for thee. And he went his way, publishing throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done for him.
